item.description: A DOJ report finds WSP followed all guidelines when no Amber Alert was issued for the three Wenatchee girls later found dead, but recommends formal checklists and improved documentation for future cases.

item.title: Cash Transactions In Washington To Round To The Nearest Nickel Starting June 2026
item.description: The federal government has stopped penny production, leading Washington State to standardize cash transactions by rounding to the nearest nickel. This change starts in mid-June 2026.

item.title: Kid Rock Explains How That Controversial Military Flyover Came to Be
item.description: According to Kid Rock, the helicopter that hovered outside his home over the weekend was already flying for a training exercise. The U.S. Army opened an investigation into the incident after some critics questioned if the flyover was a waste of taxpayer money.
